S0137.reason: Punch's traditional puppet-show wife is Judy, though the note misleadingly points to Peanuts' Peppermint Patty.

S0218.reason: Most painted caves are closed to protect the art from light and moisture damage, despite the note claiming France.

S0280.reason: Methane condenses into ice clouds only in the colder atmospheres of Uranus and Neptune, not warmer Jupiter and Saturn.

S1360.reason: The Miocene is when early non-human primate relatives (apes) first appear, despite the implausible Cambrian note.

S0439.reason: Paleogenetic and paleoecological evidence points to occupation of Australia around 60,000 years ago or more.
